title: A coord.py intent posted after its item's done progress shows state=done in the digest though it is live
goal: SP-rsmmwzr2 review G11 (ST-e3nmjd2s): digest labels an intent with the last progress event of its item wherever that event stands, so a new intent for an item that once had a done progress is shown live with state=done. Only progress later than the intent labels it.

run:
import json,os,socket,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
T='_tools/coord.py'
D=tempfile.mkdtemp()
E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(D,'c.db'))
def c(*a,t=30):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=t);return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
c('post','--kind','progress','--field','item=ST-dddddddd','--field','state=done');time.sleep(0.05)
c('post','--kind','intent','--field','item=ST-dddddddd','--field','topic=agents/z')
d=c('digest','--key','agents/z','--lines','5')[1]
print(d.strip());sys.exit(0 if 'ST-dddddddd' in d and 'state=done' not in d else 1)
